test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What will be the area (in cm²) of a semicircle whose perimeter is 72 cm? (Take π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Perimeter of the semicircle = 72 cm

π = 22/7

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of a semicircle = π × r + 2r

Area of a semicircle = (1/2) × π × r²

**Calculations:**

Perimeter = π × r + 2r

→ 72 = (22/7) × r + 2r

→ 72 = (22r + 14r)/7

→ 72 × 7 = 36r

→ 504 = 36r

→ r = 504/36 = 14 cm

Area = (1/2) × (22/7) × (14)²

→ Area = (1/2) × (22/7) × 196

→ Area = (22 × 196)/14

→ Area = 4312/14

→ Area = 308 cm²

**Therefore, the area of the semicircle is 308 cm².**
